cognitive_capacity.rationale: All 29 samples present estimation problems with numbers up to 4 digits requiring rounding to nearest hundreds or thousands, followed by subtraction. Cognitive demand is proportionate to Grade 3 expectations: students must hold two numbers, apply place-value rounding, and compute mentally without requiring complex multi-step reasoning.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample directly requires students to estimate the difference between two numbers through rounding and subtraction. The competency verb and structure are honored consistently across all formats. No sample asks for exact calculation, precision beyond rounding, or any operation other than difference estimation.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All three requirements—estimate difference, two numbers, up to 4 digits—are met across every sample. The decomposition of the competency into these three clauses is lossless and complete. No sample omits any of these three elements.

decomposition.reasoning: The three printed requirements cover the full competency without loss or redundancy. Requirement 1 captures the estimation operation, requirement 2 specifies operand count, and requirement 3 bounds the magnitude. No additional sub-competency or constraint from the full MATATAG statement is left unaddressed.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Samples span four response formats (cloze, multiple-choice, true-false, error-detect) ensuring learners encounter different interaction modes. Number pairs vary systematically: some round to hundreds, others to thousands; differences range from 0 to 5000, covering multiple magnitude classes. Error-detect items probe metacognitive verification of peer reasoning.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All operands stay within the specified range of up to 4 digits; smallest is 10, largest is 9413. Rounding targets are hundreds or thousands, both appropriate for Grade 3. The gap between operands and rounding precision is grade-appropriate, avoiding both trivial and excessively difficult cases.
